**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 of the Cobalt Cloud agreement already sits at (or above) our preferred WARRANTY position:

- **19.1** — professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel, plus material conformance of Services *and* Deliverables to documentation and specifications, with no durational cut-off on the services conformance warranty.
- **19.2** — 90 days after delivery or acceptance for Deliverables; Hosted Services conform *throughout the subscription term*, which meets or beats the preferred 12-month software period.
- **19.3** — compliance with Applicable Law and no malicious code (narrowed to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor" — a minor shortfall from preferred wording, noted in the rationale only, not redlined).
- **19.4** — re-perform/repair/replace, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, and expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. Section 6.2 supplies an additional refund route after two failed correction cycles.
- **19.5** — the disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties.

No walk-away features ("AS IS", blanket disclaimer) appear anywhere in the document.
